android.desc:
Vim Master is a learning app that helps you master Vim editor commands through interactive quizzes.
Perfect for programmers and system administrators who use Vim, or anyone who wants to learn efficient text editing.
【Who is it for?】
・Beginners who want to learn Vim from scratch
・Intermediate users who want to solidify their Vim skills
・Anyone who needs to review movement, editing, and search commands
[Key Features]
・Learn through quizzes
  - 4-choice questions to test your knowledge of Vim commands
  - Earn Bronze, Silver, and Gold badges based on your answers
・Difficulty levels
  - Choose from Easy, Normal, Hard, or Random
・Customize your practice
  - Select 5 to 150 questions per session
  - Focus on weak areas with filters like "Unanswered only" or by ID range
・Learning history
  - Track your progress with local history
  - Compete with users worldwide in World History
・Create your own questions
  -Build custom quizzes to deepen your understanding
・Multilingual support
  - Available in Japanese and English
【What you'll learn】
・Basic movement (h, j, k, l, w, b, e, etc.)
・Insert, append, delete, replace (i, a, x, c, r, etc.)
・Search and substitute (/, ?, :s, etc.)
・Yank and put (y, p)
・Visual mode, macros, and much more
Sharpen your Vim skills during your commute or in your spare time!
